properties.description: One .github/skills/<skill>/SKILL.md per served skill: the skill's own name and served description (a double-quoted scalar, so a strict YAML parser reads it), `user-invocable: false`, and a body saying to read the skill in full with `reflow2 read get_skill`. The body stays served (req:thin-install). The 37 slash commands become .github/prompts/<command>.prompt.md, each saying how to reach reflow2 through the door. Answers limitation 7.
properties.name: VS Code picks a served reflow2 skill by its description, from a stub the terminal route installs, and the slash commands are prompt files
